newsitem.title: FRANCE: Metz-Nancy-Lorraine airport Jan-Aug freight and mail.
newsitem.headline: Metz-Nancy-Lorraine airport Jan-Aug freight and mail.

text.p: Metz-Nancy-Lorraine Airport said it handled 2,406 tonnes of freight and mail traffic in the first eight months of the year, a decline of 3.3 percent on January-August 1995.
The only "all-cargo" service at the airport is a nightly Mulhouse-Metz-Paris-CDG-Metz-Mulhouse rotation operated by French airline, L'Aeropostale, using Boeing 737 QC (quick change) aircraft.
The service carries mail and express shipments.
French airline, TAT European Airlines operates a daily Metz-Paris/Orly passenger service using Fokker 28 aircraft.
The airline also operates a number passenger services from Metz to several, French provincial cities, among them Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille and Toulouse.

In the past week, public authorities in the Lorraine region said it would welcome DHL Worldwide Express's Rhine Valley cargo hub project following the collapse of a plan to install the hub at Strasbourg in neighbouring Alsace. - - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
